summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of VTC ride-hailing app (RideGo). Backend: 24/24 pytest tests PASS (100%) covering auth (register/login/me), estimates, full ride lifecycle (create->available->accept->start->complete->rate), role authorization, driver status/earnings, cancel flow. Frontend: Passenger E2E works — welcome screen, registration (name/email/phone/password + role toggle), auto-login to (passenger) tabs, home with stylized map + 'Où allez-vous?' bottom sheet + destination list, estimates screen with 3 vehicle types (Standard/Premium/Van) and correct prices, confirm ride creates ride and navigates to /ride/{id} with 'Recherche d'un chauffeur...' status and Annuler button. One clear UI defect found in tab bar (see frontend_issues).

ui_bugs.issue: The dynamic route 'ride/[id]' leaks into the bottom Tab Bar and is visible as a fourth tab labeled 'ride/[id]' with a chevron icon on every passenger screen. It should be hidden from tabs. Fix: add a <Tabs.Screen name="ride/[id]" options={{ href: null }} /> entry (or move ride/[id].tsx out of the tabs group, e.g. as a stack route inside (passenger)/ride/[id].tsx with an explicit _layout stack that opts out of Tabs).

issues: Tab labeled 'Courses' is used for ride history — problem statement / spec wording says 'Historique'; not a bug per se, but consider renaming for consistency.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — cosmetic RN Web deprecation warning.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Likely emitted from an older RN/Expo dependency; not blocking but should be watched — verify @react-navigation/* and react-native-* versions are compatible with React 19.

action_items: Hide 'ride/[id]' from the passenger Tabs layout using <Tabs.Screen name="ride/[id]" options={{ href: null }} />, or restructure so ride/[id] is a stack screen not a tab.
(Optional) Rename bottom tab 'Courses' to 'Historique' to match spec wording.
(Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RNW warnings.
(Optional) Investigate the React 19 element.ref warning source (likely a nested navigation lib) and pin/upgrade if a fix exists.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py rate average: uses `total = total_rides` after driver's total was already incremented in complete_ride, so the average formula `((prev*(total-1)) + rating)/total` is off-by-one when multiple ratings happen — first rating works correctly (prev=5, total=1 -> new = rating). Consider tracking rated_count separately or updating rating BEFORE incrementing total_rides.
server.py accept_ride correctly guards against double-accept (409 Conflict). Good.
server.py get_ride ACL logic uses `r.get('driver_id') or ''` — works but slightly awkward; explicit None-checks would be clearer.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — correct for Expo public env vars.
server.py load_dotenv timing looks correct (before os.environ reads).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical passenger flows working; 1 UI defect: ride/[id] visible in tab bar)

seed_data_creation: Created test users via /api/auth/register with prefix test_pax_* and test_drv_* (uuid-suffixed) and a few TEST rides. No production/seed data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Register endpoint lowercases email server-side — tests must use lowercase email OR assert against .lower(). pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; module-level shared `state` dict works because all tests are in one module and loadscope pins them to one worker, but if you split into multiple files use fixtures instead. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Passenger registration order of inputs is: [Nom, Email, Téléphone, Mot de passe]. Driver role toggle + conditional vehicle_model/license_plate fields not yet UI-tested end-to-end (backend validated). Ride detail polling behavior after driver acceptance also not UI-tested. Main defect to verify after fix: ride/[id] should NOT appear in the passenger tab bar.
rca_of_issue: Tab bar shows 'ride/[id]': Expo Router auto-registers every file in the (passenger) group as a Tab entry unless explicitly excluded. The file app/(passenger)/ride/[id].tsx lives inside the tabs group so Expo Router auto-adds it as a tab. Reproduction: register+login as passenger -> observe fourth tab labeled 'ride/[id]' with chevron icon. Fix options: (a) In app/(passenger)/_layout.tsx add <Tabs.Screen name="ride/[id]" options={{ href: null }} />. (b) Move ride/[id].tsx to app/ride/[id].tsx (outside tabs group) and navigate with router.push(`/ride/${id}`). Option (a) is minimal-diff and preserves current file layout.
